visualCharacteristics.structure: heading + image + price + link | image + heading + text + link

contentPattern.structure: 1 row, 2 cells. Cell 1 (product panel) = heading, product image, price text, link (button). Cell 2 (photo panel) = background photo first, then heading, text, link (button) and optional logo image. Any cell that starts with an image and also has text renders as a photo panel. 2 cells render ~30/70 from 900px.
contentPattern.notes: Static price snapshot. Ambiguity noted: could be cards (2 items) but panels are heterogeneous, so columns.
